assumed_value: Logit model: Cost (high sensitivity, mean +0.28), Green (near-zero, +0.02), Battery (moderate, +0.12)
rationale: Indian EV consumer nudge trial data is not publicly available. Grounded in Bailey et al. (openICPSR) Canadian RCT and Australian EV trials where financial incentives shifted ~49% of peak charging while moral/green suasion had no statistically significant effect.
grounding_method: Run randomized A/B trial with local DISCOM (e.g. BRPL/BYPL) or fleet telematics.

assumed_value: 5%–15% baseline shift probability without any intervention
rationale: Users occasionally charge off-peak due to routine habit or ToU awareness without receiving any nudge.
grounding_method: Pre-intervention baseline observation from smart meter interval logs.

assumed_value: Half-life of 3 days; daily nudge cap of 3 per driver; attention shadow price threshold
rationale: Human factors literature on notification burnout and habituation in driver nudges.
grounding_method: App telemetry, open rate analytics, and opt-out rate curves.

assumed_value: Mean Time Between Failures: 7 days; Mean Time to Repair: 4 hours per connector
rationale: Public charging uptime in India varies by vendor; simulated based on field surveys.
grounding_method: Real-time OCPP 1.6/2.0.1 status heartbeat telemetry feeds.

assumed_value: Minimum target arrival SOC buffer = 10% (0.10); Journey Confidence Lower Bound >= 90%
rationale: Safety invariant protecting EV drivers against stranding risk under traffic or weather variability.
grounding_method: User vehicle battery settings and historical trip telematics.

assumed_value: 150 Wh/km nominal base consumption; +12% HVAC penalty under 42°C heatwave
rationale: Physics-inspired vehicle dynamics calibrated for compact sedans and SUVs (Tata Nexon EV, MG ZS EV).
grounding_method: OBD-II and CAN-bus telematics trip datasets.

assumed_value: 12.0 MW nominal feeder capacity serving 2,000 EVs in Delhi suburban zone
rationale: 11 kV / 33 kV distribution substation feeder sizing in suburban Delhi residential cluster.
grounding_method: SCADA 15-minute feeder power logs from Delhi DISCOM.
